hierarchy: model/checkpoint -> experiment configuration -> independent run/seed -> generated samples -> metrics -> statistical analysis -> table/figure -> manuscript claim

P4_ELFB_Factorial.description: Balanced 4 x 7 x 2 factorial grid on ELF-B (32 steps, SC-CFG in {1,2,3,4}, gamma in {0,0.25,0.5,1.0,1.5,2.0,3.0}, 2 seeds/cell, 1000 samples/seed)

E3_ELFB_Refinement.description: Targeted midpoint refinement on ELF-B (32 steps, SC-CFG=1.0, gamma in {1.25, 1.75}, 2 baseline seeds + 3 P6 expansion seeds = 5 seeds/cell, 1000 samples/seed)

P6_ELFB_5Seed_Expansion.description: 5-seed replication expansion (seeds 2,3,4, 1000 samples/seed) on ELF-B matched-pair cells S1, Refined-1 (E3a), and Refined-2 (E3b)

E1_P5_P6_ELFM_Factorial.description: ELF-M 64-step evaluation across 11 (SC-CFG, gamma) cells (29 runs total), including the complete balanced 2 x 2 x 5 factorial design on SC-CFG in {1.0, 4.0} x gamma in {0.5, 2.0} (20 runs, 5 seeds/cell, 1000 samples/seed), SC=1.0 gamma=1.5 and SC=4.0 gamma=1.0 (2 seeds/cell), and SC=3.0 gamma in {0,0.5,1.0,1.5,2.0} (1 seed/cell)

E2_P6_Extended_Rescore.description: Full extended metric rescoring (H_pool, JSD_inter, within/cross distinct-1..4, 4-gram Self-BLEU, depth-6 CTW forward/reverse/Jeffreys coding divergence, position-wise entropy quartiles) on 64 runs across ELF-M and ELF-B
